# zenfra_team (Resource)

Manages a team: a group of users of the organization that space grants are given to (`zenfra_space_grant`); members are `zenfra_team_membership`. Teams do not nest. Requires an Admin token. Available after the organization's access-boundary activation; until then the API refuses every team write with `access_boundaries_inactive`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Teams, members and grants are available after the organization's
# access-boundary activation; until then the API refuses these writes.
resource "zenfra_team" "platform" {
  name        = "Platform"
  slug        = "platform"
  description = "Owns the shared networking and base stacks"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The display name of the team: not blank, no leading or trailing whitespace, at most 128 characters.
- `slug` (String) The team's identifier in the organization: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or number, at most 64 characters. Changing it replaces the team.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the team, at most 2048 characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the team.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import zenfra_team.platform $TEAM_ID
```
